articles.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
articles.description: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

articles.title: Indian opposition leaders march to top court to demand election chief resign
articles.description: The march follows a chaotic weekend in Delhi which saw thousands of protesters being detained by police.

articles.title: Ukraine strikes Yandex data centre in third attack on Russian tech giant
articles.description: It is the third time this week that Ukraine has targeted Russian tech giant Yandex, forcing the company to suspend its operations.

articles.title: Riyadh airport attacks another dangerous moment in already tense conflict
articles.description: While the physical damage from Houthi attacks can be quickly repaired, the Saudi reputation for stability is taking a battering.

articles.title: 'At least 72' miners killed in airstrike
articles.description: Dozens of miners have been killed in an airstrike in the border region between Sudan and Egypt, according to a human rights group.
